facts.business: JPT Securities Limited is engaged in financial activities, primarily giving loans and advances, and operated as a single reportable business segment during FY 2025-26.

auditor.name: JMT & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of Matter paragraphs highlight defaulted inter-corporate deposit exposures for which full provision has been recognised, liquidity constraints, outstanding statutory dues, pending income-tax matters, and material uncertainty relating to the Company's ability to continue as a going concern.

key_risks: Recovery risk in respect of outstanding financial exposures
Outcome of pending tax matters and other claims or proceedings
Material uncertainty relating to going concern
facts.related_party_note: No loans granted to promoters or related parties as defined in clause (76) of Section 2 of Companies Act 2013. The company disposed of its entire shareholding in associate company JPT Share Services Private Limited on June 10, 2026.
